methods.method_description: Click on Add icon button on Printers screen to navigate to Add Printer screen
methods.method_purpose: Initiates the add printer flow by clicking the add printer button. If the primary button is not found, it falls back to an alternative button, ensuring robust navigation across UI variations.

methods.method_description: Click on Allow button for Wi-Fi Direct printer discovery with optional permission handling

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Flag to determine whether to handle location permission dialog after clicking the Wi-Fi Direct button

methods.method_purpose: Enables Wi-Fi Direct printer discovery and conditionally handles the location permission prompt for first-time usage, ensuring proper access to printer discovery features.

methods.method_description: Click on Search icon button in Printers page to open search interface
methods.method_purpose: Navigates to the printer search screen from the main printers list view, verifying successful transition by checking for the disappearance of the printer list title.

methods.method_description: Enter search keyword into text field to filter printer list

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Search term to filter printers by name, IP address, or other identifying information

methods.method_purpose: Performs printer search by entering a keyword into the search text field, resulting in a filtered printer list or an empty list if no matches are found.

methods.method_description: Search for and select a printer using its IP address with retry logic

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: IP address of the target printer to search for and select

methods.method_purpose: Locates and selects a specific printer by IP address, using retry and scrolling mechanisms to handle cases where the printer is not immediately visible in the list.

methods.method_description: Select target printer from list using IP address or Wi-Fi Direct name with optional search

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: IP address or Wi-Fi Direct name used to identify and select the target printer
Boolean flag indicating whether to use Wi-Fi Direct printer screen (True) or network printer screen (False)
Boolean flag to determine if search functionality should be used before selecting printer
Search keyword to use when is_searched is True, for filtering printer list before selection
Maximum time in seconds to wait for printer list loading and printer availability

methods.method_purpose: Comprehensive printer selection method that handles both Wi-Fi Direct and network printers, with optional search functionality and configurable timeout for list loading. Ensures flexible and robust printer selection in dynamic UI scenarios.
